5. testPreserveRelativeLinks: ensure attribute value is updated correctly when preserveRelativeLinks false vs true.

6. testGetEnforcedAttributes: ensure map returns correct.

7. testRemoveTagCleansSubMaps: after removing tag, ensure associated attribute maps cleared.

Edge cases: passing null tags/attributes should throw IllegalArgumentException (Validate throws IllegalArgumentException). Use @Test(expected=IllegalArgumentException.class).
